claim_text: Run-scoped artifacts are byte-identical on the declared minimal path across three independent environments, and 90 run-level records are archived with per-artifact digests (traceability ledger, not cross-run determinism).
Key biological outputs are comparable to strong baselines (and/or expert annotations) on public scRNA/spatial benchmark datasets.
The system quantifies operational runtime and failure-rate evidence and records failure modes under controlled reruns and stress tests.
